TARS PR #58 — W2 LEGACY_REPAIR_ARCHIVE_FENCING review scope

Authorized intentional behavior change:
- F1/F2/F3/G1/G2/E1 receipt repair/archive housekeeping is metadata/projection-only and must not mint or restamp financial authority.
- Existing source state is preserved by housekeeping: confirmed may remain confirmed; legacy remains legacy; pre remains pre; rejected remains rejected; archive_failed remains archive_failed.
- For a pre-existing legacy row already counted by baseline acceptedReceiptEntry before housekeeping, require zero NEW financial effect from housekeeping: no new counted/index row or duplicate projection and post-run count/total equal pre-run values for the same fixture.
- A new F3 repair observation may be created only as source=pre and must create zero financial count/total delta.
- Housekeeping must make zero PAS authority calls and must not emit accepted-success UX.

Explicitly out of scope / BLOCK if introduced:
- W3/global acceptedReceiptEntry or source-counting policy changes.
- H1/H2 or P1/P2/P5 index-merge/projection canonicalization.
- PAS schema/authority semantics changes.
- AUTO/MANUAL confirmation policy changes outside preserving W1 behavior.
- OCR/provider/date policy expansion unrelated to these housekeeping fences.
- migration/import/seeding.
- deploy/cutover/production mutation.

Review must block any broader behavioral change than the bounded W2 housekeeping fence above.
